d: US Representative Robert Garcia has hit back at the Trump White House after counsel Will Scharf warned Democrats against launching investigations into the administration. Garcia accused Donald Trump of hiding something and vowed that Democrats would not be intimidated. Defending his 'lawyer up' warning, Garcia said officials accused of abusing the American public should face accountability. He also alleged corruption involving Trump's family, DHS and ICE.
